title: BasinGraph: bounded operational search-state optimization
description: Version 3.1.0 integrates the frozen BasinGraph 2.0.0-rc1 result-bearing implementation with documentation and reproducibility metadata for the registered Track A-D/C evidence extensions. The optimizer maintains a fixed-capacity archive of operational search-state representatives, a directed graph of observed transitions and exact objective-evaluation accounting. This release does not revise the result-bearing candidate, its options hash or any confirmatory outcome. It adds evidence manifests, protocol references, Source Data mappings, figure sources and claim-boundary documentation for mechanism ablation, modern-baseline comparisons, 40-320-dimensional scalability and scientific-model and NIST observed-data applications.
